patronOf.pt-BR: Padroeiro dos bispos e do estudo

prayerExcerpt.en-US: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Quando em Roma, faze como os romanos.

meta.face: A man in early middle age around 45, short dark-brown hair receding at the temples, a short close dark-brown beard and moustache, broad forehead, long straight nose, intense direct gaze.
meta.basis: The 5th-century mosaic in San Vittore in Ciel d'Oro, Milan, possibly a portrait from life.
